new_candidate.name: Bacterial OrthoBench2 / gamma-Proteobacteria RefOGs
new_candidate.archive_url_documentation_scope: SwiftOrtho supplementary methods Table S1 identifies orthobench2.all.data.tar.gz at the legacy author site. Supplementary reference assignments were not downloaded or opened.
new_candidate.published_scope: 49 manually curated bacterial reference groups, containing 4698 reference orthologs. The study targets the gamma-Proteobacteria ancestral level using 238 genomes and additional outgroups during curation; the initial search considered 385 bacterial genomes. The paper reports 19 universal families that also occur in eukaryotes.
new_candidate.published_method_context: Curated trees, iterative profile-HMM recruitment and manual treatment of outgroups/HGT support the reference. Functional concordance is not a substitute for the stated evolutionary target.
new_candidate.request_policy: Four bounded HEAD requests, 5-second connect and 10-second read timeouts, redirects allowed. No archive body, sequence, assignment, alignment, HMM, tree or supplementary classification bytes were acquired. Source-paper prose and public metadata were reviewed; this is not a claim that the literature itself was blinded.
new_candidate.availability_conclusion: The four tested legacy endpoints did not provide the resource at review time. HEAD 404 responses are endpoint observations, not proof that all mirrors or archives are absent. No unbounded archive hunt or author contact was started.
future_admission_gates: Obtain release-matched complete proteomes and provenance from an appropriate public archive; reference-family FASTAs alone are not complete search backgrounds.

Before inspecting assignments, audit input-sequence/taxon overlap with all exposed inputs and reference-family reuse with the bilaterian benchmark. Different kingdoms do not prove independent families, especially for the universal families reported by the authors.

Freeze the selected OrthoHMM method, comparator versions and protocol before any reference-assignment access or scoring. Keep the complete predefined eligible panel rather than selecting favorable families or the nonmatching sequence remainder.

Specify the gamma-Proteobacteria ancestral-group target and treatment of outgroups and HGT; do not score whole-input-root groups against a different ancestral-level reference without an explicit validated mapping.
Separate curated-reference transfer from strict sequence/family-disjoint biological confirmation. Reproduce controls and official/reference semantics before adding a new endpoint or claim.
new_candidate.decision: Potential bacterial curated-reference transfer panel only; not currently staged or eligible as an independent benchmark. Availability, overlap and semantics remain unresolved but nonblocking. Do not change the protected-union experiment or infer new accuracy scores from this review.

CGOB.decision: Preserve as a possible frozen-candidate curated fungal transfer panel, not strict input-disjoint confirmation. ON/OFF eligibility, taxon mapping, ancestral semantics and redistribution remain separate gates. The existing audit and independent readback are inherited here, not repeated.

ParaBench.decision: Near-total corrected-QfO sequence overlap rules out strict input-disjoint confirmation; renamed identifiers do not remove exposure. No accuracy scoring or favorable-remainder selection.

Simulation.decision: Existing panels are development-exposed. A new seed panel may provide prospective confirmation conditional on the simulator only after method freeze, seed-reuse audit and a committed generation/evaluation protocol. It cannot independently validate biological model assumptions. No new simulations, truths or accuracy evaluations were generated in this review.

local_review_scope: Reread and rehashed the previous review, CGOB independent readback, ParaBench audit and simulation preparation source; checked their stated counts and label-access flags. Also checked the cited CGOB source-audit pin. Did not repeat every overlap calculation or claim to audit every historical local path. A bounded exact-name search of current top-level benchmark tools found no existing OrthoBench2 confirmation workflow; absence from that search is not proof of historical nonexposure.
selection_and_continuation: Continue the live complete-proteome OrthoBench protected-union pilot under its committed strict F1/precision/recall gate. Only a passing independently admitted pilot can justify separately prespecified unchanged-setting QfO/Three Kingdoms inference. Freeze any selected method before new confirmation scoring. No new confirmation panel is a prerequisite to finishing the current development round, and no missing archive or imperfect independence may become a repeated execution blocker.
previous_goal_turn_classification: progress; admitted new independently verified shared-hit native/functional composition diagnostics and pushed their tested evidence
current_goal_turn_classification: progress; reviewed a new primary-source curated transfer candidate, checked four actual metadata endpoints, and recorded concrete availability and interpretation limits without exposing assignments or duplicating inference
